title: Not as smart as Mealime
body: Does a decent job bringing in Mealime recipes. The ai photos on the app are off putting. Does a god awful job importing from a photo. Does well with importing from websites. The grocery list isn’t smart. I typed milk and it assumed it was canned.

title: Replacement Mealime!
body: So far a great app! It’s very similar to Mealime and has the same backbone of creating recipes for the week and reducing waste. So happy it was built!

title: Fantastic Mealime Replacement
body: I downloaded this app because Mealime is shutting down and so far it has been fantastic. I really like a lot of the features that it has that others do not especially how easy it is to add ingredients to your shopping list and have them auto populate for future meal planning.

title: Better than Mealime
body: Im cheering these folks on! I hope their team grows and they get to the point of hiring a chef. The app’s functionality is great! It has everything you want: - recipes that are actually meals (not just one side or one main) - family sharing (linked accounts) and accounting for individual portion sizes - metric/imperial conversions - check-off grocery list that you can add to AND organize to match how your grocery store is actually laid out (no scrolling to find the section youre walking through) - nutrition info and filtering (and setup and meal restriction preferences) - meal planning by day if you want to - favoriting AND ratings for meals - super duper easy importing of external recipes (seriously, surprisingly easy) - cooking mode with hands free and integrated timers - save whats in your pantry (if you want to) - SUPER RESPONSIVE TEAM. Im not kidding, they actually emailed me back with a fix to my issue. Im rooting for these developers and this app! This is exactly what I was looking for when Mealime closed. Thank you and keep going!
